## 🔴 Authorization means through to merge — LAW (Jose, 2026-09-26, "for perpetuity")

An approval, authorization or go-ahead covers the **whole arc**: diagnose → fix → code → tests →
PR → drive to green → merge on `main`, ready to deploy. The deliverable is a merged, green
change — never a finding, a proposal, or an offer.

- A blocker you hit **while doing the authorized task** — a gate bug, a tooling bug, a CI or test
  defect — **is part of the task.** Fix it in its own PR, drive that green, merge it, then finish.
- Never end with *"out of scope — want me to fix it?"* for something the authorization already
  covers. That re-ask is the failure.
- Unchanged: hard walls (secrets, real capital, destructive acts, protected paths, governance
  carve-outs) still go to Jose — driven fully green and left one tap from merge. Physical operator
  actions (the box, a Settings page) are still his hands: one complete step, no blanks. Never
  evade a gate to finish.
- Canonical text: mantra Rule 16 in `HamRadio08/claude-memory` `mantra_prime_directive.md`; record
  `feedback_authorization_means_through_to_merge.md`. The gated copy lives in
  `HamRadio08/ai-trading-agents` `CLAUDE.md`.
